caption: The drawing features a single brown jug with a rounded body and a narrow neck, depicted in the center of a pale beige background. The jug has a decorative, textured band that spirals around its body and neck, resembling a snake or coiled rope, ending with a sculpted animal or dragon head attached to the side near the mouth. There is a single handle connecting the neck to the upper body of the jug. The surface of the jug is mottled with shades of reddish-brown and dark brown, representing the ceramic material and giving a slightly glossy impression. Below the jug, there is a faint, semi-circular pencil outline labeled “Detail of Base” with the handwritten words “California Mo.” inside the arc. Next to this base detail, there is printed text that reads “BISBY” and “FINLEY.” There are no additional objects or background details in the composition.
title: Pottery Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
